doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/scene8_pod_latch.state (the owner's snes9x capture below the Telepod's left pod after Marle vanished, spliced over scene8_gate_cutscene.state): the playthrough's leg 11 end (loc 008, storyline 0C, control back), Crono walked left 44 and up 33 frames -- at (0437,07E9) below the left pod (obj11 at tile (4,5)), the capture's (0437,07EC) but for a quarter pixel of sub-position; Up from here touches the pod (obj11's fn2) in about 21 frames, as the capture's drives expect.
